title: Beyond Earth: How AI is Transforming Space Exploration
description: AI is used in space exploration for rovers, mission planning, data analysis, autonomy, and decisions made far beyond easy rescue.
short_description: A practical look at rovers, mission planning, data analysis, autonomy, and why space AI has no room for cheerful guesswork.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in space exploration for science readers, engineers, mission planners, and anyone tracking research-heavy systems.
